initial_delta.note: The KB does not model the identity of the zakat recipient, so the new Lampiran list and the revocation rule (Pasal 1 ayat (3)-(5)) are modelled as an exception that sets zakat_deductible to 0 when the case marks the recipient body as not listed (employer attribute zakat_recipient_listed == False). The existing REG.ZAKAT.DEDUCTIBLE stays unchanged; valid_from is the first day of the March 2026 tax period, as the regulation takes effect on 30 March 2026.

The KB does not model recipient identity, and the existing REG.ZAKAT.DEDUCTIBLE rule already covers zakat paid through the employer, so the PPh 21 computation does not change.

output.reason: The regulation replaces PER-04/PJ/2022 and its amendments with a new consolidated list of government-established or approved zakat and compulsory religious donation recipients. Payments to these bodies may be deducted from gross income. For permanent employees, zakat paid through the employer to a listed body reduces net income in the PPh 21 calculation, so changing the list changes which deductions qualify. The new list includes bodies approved up to February 2026. It also adds a rule that payments made after a body's licence is revoked and it is removed from the list are not deductible.
